_how: fit / test split of capstone_datasets, held out by camera or scene. Rebuild with make_splits.py <dataset root>; the assignment is a fixed table, so any copy of the download yields this same file. One record per LABEL FILE; 'scene' is the unit held out, so group on it for any further split. Records with 'same_video_as' set share byte-identical footage with that video in another anomaly folder and carry a different annotation of it - group on 'video_key' to decode each video once and score it against the union of its label files.
